   "source": [
    "##------------------ VNA LIBRARY ------------------\n",
    "## Autor: Leonardo David Vazquez\n",
    "## Version: v6.0\n",
    "## Fecha: 21/10/2024\n",
    "## Lugar: Laboratorio de Comunicaciones FI UNMDP\n",
    "## Comentario:  Funciones para realizar un barrido frecuencial y generar un conjunto de parametros S a partir de\n",
    "#               la adquisición de señales de audio, procesado de señales, etc. \n",
    "#               Envío de frecuencias por UART y reepción de señales de audio por USB CODEC \n",
    "# --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "# Inicialización de librerías y funciones\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "# Librerias\n",
    "import sounddevice as sd\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "from scipy import interpolate\n",
    "from scipy.signal import butter, filtfilt, savgol_filter\n",
    "from scipy.fft import fft, fftfreq\n",
    "import plotly.io as pio\n",
    "pio.renderers.default = \"notebook\"\n",
    "import plotly.graph_objects as go \n",
    "import time\n",
    "#import adf4351 as adf\n",
    "import serial\n",
    "import time\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "#------------- UART SEND FREQUENCY ------------\n",
    "# --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "\n",
    "# Función para enviar frecuencia por UART\n",
    "def enviar_frecuencias_por_uart(frecuencia):\n",
    "    global ser\n",
    "    # Espera un momento para asegurarte de que la conexión se establezca\n",
    "    time.sleep(0.01)\n",
    "    frecuencia = int(frecuencia)\n",
    "    hex_str = hex(frecuencia)[2:].zfill(4)\n",
    "    parte1 = hex_str[:2].upper()\n",
    "    parte2 = hex_str[2:].upper()\n",
    "\n",
    "    #print(frecuencia)\n",
    "    # Convertir la frecuencia en dos bytes (formato little-endian)\n",
    "    paquetei = bytearray()\n",
    "    paquetei.append(0x01)\n",
    "    ser.write(paquetei)\n",
    "    paquete1 = bytearray.fromhex(parte1)\n",
    "    #print(paquete1.hex())\n",
    "    # Enviar los dos bytes por UART\n",
    "    ser.write(paquete1)\n",
    "    paquete2 = bytearray.fromhex(parte2)\n",
    "    #print(paquete2.hex())\n",
    "    # Enviar los dos bytes por UART\n",
    "    ser.write(paquete2)\n",
    "\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "# Parámetros de Grabación\n",
    "# --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "#sampling_rate = 44100  # Frecuencia de muestreo\n",
    "#duration = 0.1  # Duración de la grabación en segundos\n",
    "channels = 2  # Número de canales (estéreo)\n",
    "input_device_index = 1  # Índice del dispositivo de entrada\n",
    "\n",
    "# Asignar el dispositivo de entrada\n",
    "sd.default.device = (input_device_index, None)  # (entrada, salida)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Función para capturar audio\n",
    "def capture_audio():\n",
    "    #print(\"Grabando..\")\n",
    "    input_device_index = 1  # Índice del dispositivo de entrada\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Asignar el dispositivo de entrada\n",
    "    sd.default.device = (input_device_index, None)  # (entrada, salida)\n",
    "\n",
    "    audio_data = sd.rec(int(duration * sampling_rate), samplerate=sampling_rate, channels=2, dtype='float64')\n",
    "    sd.wait()\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Calcular el índice de inicio a partir del 20% de la duración\n",
    "    start_index = int(0.2 * duration * sampling_rate)\n",
    "    # Descartar el 20% de las primeras muestras\n",
    "    left_channel = audio_data[start_index:, 0]  # Canal izquierdo\n",
    "    right_channel = audio_data[start_index:, 1]  # Canal derecho\n",
    "    # Todas las muestras\n",
    "    #left_channel = audio_data[:, 0]  # Canal izquierdo\n",
    "    #right_channel = audio_data[:, 1]  # Canal derecho\n",
    "    \n",
    "    return left_channel, right_channel\n",
    "\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "# Filtro Digital Butterworth Band-Pass\n",
    "# --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "\n",
    "def butter_bandpass(lowcut, highcut, fs, order=2):\n",
    "    nyq = 0.5 * fs  # Frecuencia de Nyquist\n",
    "    low = lowcut / nyq\n",
    "    high = highcut / nyq\n",
    "    b, a = butter(order, [low, high], btype='band')\n",
    "    return b, a\n",
    "\n",
    "# Función para aplicar el filtro\n",
    "def apply_bandpass_filter(data, lowcut, highcut, fs, order=2):\n",
    "    b, a = butter_bandpass(lowcut, highcut, fs, order=order)\n",
    "    y = filtfilt(b, a, data)\n",
    "    return y\n",
    "\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "# Cálculos de Amplitud y Fase mediante FFT\n",
    "# --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "\n",
    "def fft_amplitude_phase(signal, sampling_rate, duration):\n",
    "    # Calcular la FFT de la señal\n",
    "    fft_signal = np.fft.fft(signal)\n",
    "    frequencies = np.fft.fftfreq(len(signal), 1 / sampling_rate)\n",
    "    N = duration * sampling_rate\n",
    "    amps = np.array((2.0 / N) * np.abs(fft_signal))\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # Limitar las frecuencias a las positivas\n",
    "    freqs_positive = frequencies[:int(N // 2)]\n",
    "    amps_positive = amps[:int(N // 2)]\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # Definir la frecuencia objetivo y la tolerancia\n",
    "    target_freq = 1000.0  # 1 kHz\n",
    "    tolerance = 50.0  # Tolerancia de ±900 Hz\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # Encontrar los índices de las frecuencias cercanas a 1 kHz dentro de la tolerancia\n",
    "    indices = np.where((freqs_positive >= (target_freq - tolerance)) & (freqs_positive <= (target_freq + tolerance)))[0]\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # Seleccionar la componente con la mayor amplitud\n",
    "    max_index = indices[np.argmax(amps_positive[indices])]\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # Calcular la fase y amplitud de esa componente\n",
    "    phase = -np.degrees(np.angle(fft_signal[max_index]))  # en grados\n",
    "    amp = amps_positive[max_index]\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # Obtener la frecuencia exacta de la componente de mayor amplitud\n",
    "    #exact_freq = freqs_positive[max_index]\n",
    "    # Imprimir la frecuencia exacta\n",
    "    #print(f\"Componente: {exact_freq} Hz\")\n",
    "    \n",
    "    return amp, phase\n",
    "\n",
    "def phase_adjust(diff_phase):\n",
    "    x = diff_phase\n",
    "    if (x > 180.0):\n",
    "        x = x - 360.0\n",
    "    if (x < -180):\n",
    "        x = x + 360.0\n",
    "    return x\n",
    "\n",
    "def calculate_amplitude_phase(signal_1,signal_2,sampling_rate,duration):\n",
    "    amp_1, phase_1 = fft_amplitude_phase(signal_1, sampling_rate, duration)\n",
    "    amp_2, phase_2 = fft_amplitude_phase(signal_2, sampling_rate, duration)\n",
    "    dif_phase = phase_adjust(-phase_1+phase_2)\n",
    "    #print(\"amp1 \",amp_1)\n",
    "    #print(\"amp2 \",amp_2)\n",
    "    #print(\"phase\",dif_phase)\n",
    "    transfer = amp_2/amp_1\n",
    "    return transfer,dif_phase\n",
    "\n",
    "# Función para calcular la amplitud y fase\n",
    "def calculate_fft(signal, fs):\n",
    "    # Aplicar la FFT\n",
    "    N = len(signal)\n",
    "    fft_values = fft(signal)\n",
    "    freq_values = fftfreq(N, 1/fs)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Calcular amplitud y fase\n",
    "    amplitude = np.abs(fft_values)\n",
    "    phase = np.angle(fft_values)\n",
    "\n",
    "    return freq_values, amplitude, phase\n",
    "\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "# Parámetro S: Función constructora\n",
    "# --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "def s_parameter(amp,phase):\n",
    "    s = amp* np.exp(1j*(np.radians(phase)))   \n",
    "    return s\n",
    "\n",
    "def db_phase(sp):\n",
    "     magnitude = np.abs(sp)\n",
    "     magnitude_dB = 20.0*np.log10(magnitude)\n",
    "     phase_deg = np.angle(sp, deg=True)\n",
    "     return magnitude,magnitude_dB, phase_deg\n",
    "\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "# Función de Impedancímetro\n",
    "# --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "def impedancimeter(Gamma,Zo = 50.0):\n",
    "    n = len(Gamma)\n",
    "    ZL = np.empty(n, dtype=complex)\n",
    "    for i in range(n):\n",
    "        ZL[i] = Zo * (1 + Gamma[i])/(1 - Gamma[i])\n",
    "    return ZL \n",
    "\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "# Calibración\n",
    "# --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "\n",
    "# Error function\n",
    "def error_calculator(GM_CC,GM_50,GM_CA,n):\n",
    "\n",
    "    e_00 = np.empty(n, dtype=complex)\n",
    "    e_11 = np.empty(n, dtype=complex)\n",
    "    delta_e = np.empty(n, dtype=complex)\n",
    "\n",
    "    for i in range(n):       \n",
    "        A = np.array([\n",
    "            [1.0,-GM_CC[i],1.0], #CC\n",
    "            [1.0,0.0,0.0],         #50\n",
    "            [1.0,GM_CA[i],-1.0]  #CA\n",
    "        ],dtype=complex)\n",
    "        B = np.array([GM_CC[i],GM_50[i],GM_CA[i]])\n",
    "        sol = np.linalg.solve(A, B)\n",
    "        #sol =  np.float64(sol)\n",
    "        e_00[i] = sol[0]\n",
    "        e_11[i] = sol[1]\n",
    "        delta_e[i] = sol[2]    \n",
    "\n",
    "    return e_00,e_11,delta_e\n",
    "\n",
    "# Gamma corrector\n",
    "def gamma_corrector(GM,GM_CC,GM_50,GM_CA,n):\n",
    "\n",
    "    e_00,e_11,delta_e = error_calculator(GM_CC,GM_50,GM_CA,n)\n",
    "    Gamma = np.empty(n, dtype=complex)\n",
    "\n",
    "    for i in range(n):\n",
    "        #print(i)\n",
    "        Gamma[i] = (GM[i]-e_00[i])/(GM[i]*e_11[i]-delta_e[i])\n",
    "    #print(\"S11/S22: \",Gamma)\n",
    "    return Gamma\n",
    "\n",
    "# Transfer corrector\n",
    "def transfer_corrector(GDUT,e30,e1032,n):\n",
    "    G = np.empty(n, dtype=complex)\n",
    "    for i in range(n):\n",
    "        G[i] = (GDUT[i]-e30[i])/e1032[i]\n",
    "    #print(\"S21/S12: \",G)\n",
    "    return G\n",
    "\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "# Adquisición de S11/S22 S12/S21\n",
    "# --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "def s11_capture(duration,sampling_rate):\n",
    "    # Capturar las señales de audio\n",
    "    ix_signal, rev_signal = capture_audio()\n",
    "    time_axis = np.linspace(0, duration, len(ix_signal))\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Aplicar filtro pasa banda a ambas señales\n",
    "    lowcut = 950.0\n",
    "    highcut = 1050.0\n",
    "    ix_signal_filtered = apply_bandpass_filter(ix_signal, lowcut, highcut, sampling_rate)\n",
    "    rev_signal_filtered = apply_bandpass_filter(rev_signal, lowcut, highcut, sampling_rate)\n",
    " \n",
    "\n",
    "    # Calcular Amplitud y Fase\n",
    "    S11_amp, S11_phase = calculate_amplitude_phase(ix_signal_filtered,rev_signal_filtered,sampling_rate,duration)\n",
    "    S11_amp_adjust =  -S11_amp*286.0/40.0\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Generar parámetro S:\n",
    "    sp = s_parameter(S11_amp_adjust,S11_phase)\n",
    "    return sp\n",
    "\n",
    "def s21_capture(duration,sampling_rate):\n",
    "    # Capturar las señales de audio\n",
    "    tx_signal, ix_signal = capture_audio()\n",
    "    time_axis = np.linspace(0, duration, len(ix_signal))\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Aplicar filtro pasa banda a ambas señales\n",
    "    lowcut = 950.0\n",
    "    highcut = 1050.0\n",
    "    ix_signal_filtered = apply_bandpass_filter(ix_signal, lowcut, highcut, sampling_rate)\n",
    "    tx_signal_filtered = apply_bandpass_filter(tx_signal, lowcut, highcut, sampling_rate)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Calcular la amplitud y fase de las señales filtradas\n",
    "    #freq_left, amplitude_left, phase_left = calculate_fft(ix_signal_filtered, sampling_rate)\n",
    "    #freq_right, amplitude_right, phase_right = calculate_fft(tx_signal_filtered, sampling_rate)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Graficar la amplitud y fase de la señal filtrada del canal izquierdo\n",
    "    #plot_fft(freq_left, amplitude_left, phase_left, \"Canal Izquierdo: IX\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Graficar la amplitud y fase de la señal filtrada del canal derecho\n",
    "    #plot_fft(freq_right, amplitude_right, phase_right, \"Canal Derecho: TX\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Calcular Amplitud y Fase\n",
    "    S21_amp, S21_phase = calculate_amplitude_phase(ix_signal_filtered,tx_signal_filtered,sampling_rate,duration)\n",
    "    S21_amp_adjust =  S21_amp*25.0\n",
    "    # Generar parámetro S:\n",
    "    sp = s_parameter(S21_amp_adjust,S21_phase)\n",
    "    return sp\n",
    "\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "#  Mediciones S11, S21\n",
    "# --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def medicion_s(tipo,duration,sampling_rate):\n",
    "    s = []\n",
    "    if tipo == \"S11\":\n",
    "        s =  s11_capture(duration,sampling_rate)\n",
    "    elif tipo == \"S21\":\n",
    "        s = s21_capture(duration,sampling_rate) \n",
    "    return s \n",
    "    \n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "#  Smothing Promediado Savitzky-Golay\n",
    "# --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "\n",
    "def smothing_savgol(s):\n",
    "    S_real_smooth = savgol_filter(s.real, window_length=5, polyorder=1)\n",
    "    S_imag_smooth = savgol_filter(s.imag, window_length=5, polyorder=1)\n",
    "    S_smooth = S_real_smooth + 1j * S_imag_smooth\n",
    "    return S_smooth\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "# -------- Gráfica Auxiliar\n",
    "# --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "# Función para graficar magnitud y fase\n",
    "def graficar_magnitud_y_fase_vs_frecuencia(S21_freqs, S21_Att):\n",
    "    # Crear una figura con dos subgráficas (una para magnitud y otra para fase)\n",
    "    # Crear una figura\n",
    "    plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6), facecolor='white')\n",
    "    # Obtener los ejes actuales\n",
    "    ax = plt.gca()\n",
    "    # Asegurar que el área de la gráfica también tenga fondo blanco\n",
    "    ax.set_facecolor('white')\n",
    "    # Subplot para la magnitud\n",
    "    plt.subplot(2, 1, 1)  # 2 filas, 1 columna, primera posición\n",
    "       # Calcular la magnitud y convertirla a dB\n",
    "    magnitud = np.abs(S21_Att)\n",
    "    magnitud_dB = 20.0 * np.log10(magnitud)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Graficar magnitud en dB vs frecuencia\n",
    "    plt.plot(S21_freqs, magnitud_dB, marker='.',  linewidth=2.5)\n",
    "    # Añadir título y etiquetas de los ejes para la magnitud\n",
    "    plt.title('Magnitud y Fase')\n",
    "    plt.xlabel('Frecuencia (MHz)')\n",
    "    plt.ylabel('Magnitud (dB)')\n",
    "    plt.legend()\n",
    "    plt.grid(True)\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # Subplot para la fase\n",
    "    plt.subplot(2, 1, 2)  # 2 filas, 1 columna, segunda posición\n",
    "    # Calcular la fase en grados\n",
    "    fase = np.angle(S21_Att, deg=True)\n",
    "    # Graficar fase vs frecuencia\n",
    "    plt.plot(S21_freqs, fase, marker='.',  linewidth=2.5)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Añadir etiquetas de los ejes para la fase\n",
    "    plt.xlabel('Frecuencia (MHz)')\n",
    "    plt.ylabel('Fase (grados)')\n",
    "    #plt.legend()\n",
    "    plt.grid(True)\n",
    "    # Ajustar el espaciado para que no se sobrepongan los subplots\n",
    "    plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "    #plt.savefig(\"Atenuador_uVNA.png\", dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight', format='png')  # Puedes cambiar el formato a 'pdf' o 'svg' si deseas\n",
    "    # Mostrar la gráfica\n",
    "    plt.show()\n",
    "\n",
    "def graficar_magnitud_y_fase_vs_frecuencia2(S21_freqs, S21_Att):\n",
    "    # Crear una figura con dos subgráficas (una para magnitud y otra para fase)\n",
    "    plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6), facecolor='white')\n",
    "    ax = plt.gca()\n",
    "    ax.set_facecolor('white')\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Subplot para la magnitud\n",
    "    plt.subplot(2, 1, 1)  # 2 filas, 1 columna, primera posición\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Calcular la magnitud y convertirla a dB\n",
    "    magnitud = np.abs(S21_Att)\n",
    "    magnitud_dB = 20.0 * np.log10(magnitud)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Crear una interpolación de los datos (con el tipo de interpolación deseado)\n",
    "    f_interp_mag = interpolate.interp1d(S21_freqs, magnitud_dB, kind='cubic')\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # Crear un nuevo conjunto de frecuencias más denso para suavizar la curva\n",
    "    freqs_interp = np.linspace(min(S21_freqs), max(S21_freqs), num=500)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Graficar magnitud interpolada en dB vs frecuencia\n",
    "    plt.plot(freqs_interp, f_interp_mag(freqs_interp), marker='',  linewidth=2.5)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Añadir título y etiquetas de los ejes para la magnitud\n",
    "    plt.title('Magnitud y Fase')\n",
    "    plt.xlabel('Frecuencia (MHz)')\n",
    "    plt.ylabel('Magnitud (dB)')\n",
    "    plt.legend()\n",
    "    plt.grid(True)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Subplot para la fase\n",
    "    plt.subplot(2, 1, 2)  # 2 filas, 1 columna, segunda posición\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Calcular la fase en grados\n",
    "    fase = np.angle(S21_Att, deg=True)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Crear una interpolación de los datos de fase\n",
    "    f_interp_fase = interpolate.interp1d(S21_freqs, fase, kind='cubic')\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Graficar fase interpolada vs frecuencia\n",
    "    plt.plot(freqs_interp, f_interp_fase(freqs_interp), marker='', linewidth=2.5)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Añadir etiquetas de los ejes para la fase\n",
    "    plt.xlabel('Frecuencia (MHz)')\n",
    "    plt.ylabel('Fase (grados)')\n",
    "    plt.grid(True)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Ajustar el espaciado para que no se sobrepongan los subplots\n",
    "    plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "    plt.show()\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# Función para graficar amplitud y fase\n",
    "def plot_fft(freq, amplitude, phase, channel_name):\n",
    "    plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Graficar amplitud\n",
    "    plt.subplot(2, 1, 1)\n",
    "    plt.plot(freq, amplitude, color='red')\n",
    "    plt.title(f'Amplitud de la señal ({channel_name})')\n",
    "    plt.xlabel('Frecuencia [Hz]')\n",
    "    plt.ylabel('Amplitud')\n",
    "    plt.xlim(0, 2000)  # Limitar a la mitad de la frecuencia de muestreo\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Graficar fase\n",
    "    plt.subplot(2, 1, 2)\n",
    "    plt.plot(freq, phase, color='purple')\n",
    "    plt.title(f'Fase de la señal ({channel_name})')\n",
    "    plt.xlabel('Frecuencia [Hz]')\n",
    "    plt.ylabel('Fase [radianes]')\n",
    "    plt.xlim(0, 2000)\n",
    "\n",
    "    plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "    plt.show()\n",
    "\n",
    "# --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "# Función de Barridos\n",
    "# --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "# Barrido de frecuencias y cálculo de registros\n",
    "def barrido_frecuencia(f_in, deltaf, f_end,tipo,duration,sampling_rate,muestras):\n",
    "    global ser\n",
    "    # Definir las frecuencias problemáticas como números con un decimal\n",
    "    frecuencias_a_omitir = set([301, 303, 352, 357, 358, 361, 363, 364, 367, 370, 374, 376, 377, 380, 383, 384, 387, 391, 394, 398, 399, 401, 402, 406, 407, 409, 414, 415, 417, 422, 423, 425,    "source": [
    "from scipy.signal import butter\n",
    "\n",
    "# Parámetros del filtro\n",
    "lowcut = 950.0        # Frecuencia baja de corte (Hz)\n",
    "highcut = 1050.0      # Frecuencia alta de corte (Hz)\n",
    "fs = 44100.0           # Frecuencia de muestreo (Hz)\n",
    "order = 2             # Orden del filtro\n",
    "\n",
    "# Obtención de coeficientes b y a\n",
    "nyq = 0.5 * fs\n",
    "low = lowcut / nyq\n",
    "high = highcut / nyq\n",
    "b, a = butter(order, [low, high], btype='band')\n",
    "\n",
    "# Mostrando los coeficientes para la función de transferencia\n",
    "print(\"Numerador B(z):\", b)\n",
    "print(\"Denominador A(z):\", a)"
   ]
  }
